title: Help needed. JRPG 2D-HD Ability VFX question
author: Consistent-Ice5770
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/94i77yopb60i1.png

https://i.redd.it/zmse17nqb60i1.png

https://i.redd.it/2msiqbesb60i1.png

I'm working with my nephew on a small 3-person team. He's the developer, and I handle the creative side (UI design, mockups, visual direction, etc.). We're currently trying to align on the VFX style for abilities.

Screenshot 1 shows the current state of the ability VFX, but my goal is for them to look more like Screenshot 2. My nephew feels they're essentially the same, but to me there are some noticeable differences.

Specifically, when the VFX in Screenshot 1 animate, they appear stretched, wavy, and somewhat low-budget. They don't have the crisp, clean 2D-HD look that I see in Screenshot 2. The motion feels distorted rather than sharp and intentional.

I notice the same issue in Screenshot 3, which is the side-by-side ability comparison. The animation seems to have a stretchy/warping quality that makes it feel different from the visual style I'm aiming for.

I'm looking for clarification on what I'm seeing from a VFX/art perspective so that we can use the same terminology, get on the same page, and communicate more effectively as collaborators.
